name: Tile-grilled meat
summary: Meat grilled on a tile, the evening plate Visit Lâm Đồng names at one Nguyễn Lương Bằng door.
origin: Visit Lâm Đồng’s food-tour note names nướng ngói at Cu Đức. It does not list the meats.
howToEat: The note says have the grill in the evening if lunch was a hotpot. What is on the tile was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Cu Đức, 6A Nguyễn Lương Bằng. Hours are Check on arrival.
priceBand: The food-tour note prints 100,000–200,000 VND a person.
